source_sha_tracking: Git blob SHA per daily file
wind_direction_notes: Original numeric codes retained. Head/tail relative venue orientation NOT inferred.
limits: Wind is measured with race result data, so never use these weather values as predeadline input.
Differences are unadjusted within a single calendar month, not causal effects.
Race- and athlete-mix, class, timing, wind direction and venue may confound outcomes.
Course-specific win rate is not 1-gate/1-boat win rate.
Small n or missingness disqualifies a strong venue conclusion.
No coefficients or forecasts changed; this is only descriptive research.
